units.name: Scene0InitializeWalkingObject
units.summary: Clear object stream cursors, select horizontal stream 1, vertical stream 0 and animation 1 and advance the object state. The paired walking states sample the map at offsets 16,16, stop vertical movement on support and route contact to state 3.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeTurningObject
units.summary: Start motion 4 and animation 56. Relative player X differences of0,32 or128 switch to animation 4/motion 0; animation 56 restores motion 4. All paths share contact handling.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeDiagonalWatcher
units.summary: Start motion 2, animation 5. A visible object compares half the horizontal player distance with vertical separation before starting vertical stream 5 and animation 6; player contact switches to state 3.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializePatrolObject
units.summary: Start motion 16/animation 34. The following mirrored patrol states probe both horizontal sides, reverse on map boundaries, and sometimes switch to vertical movement when the player lies in a narrow horizontal window. Random low bits vary the decision; contact selects state 5.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0ResolvePatrolLanding
units.summary: Probe at offsets 15,16 or15,0 according to facing. A nonzero correction subtracts from working Y, resets cursors and restores the corresponding walking motion 16/17 and animation 34/35. Other paths retain the common contact response.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeVerticalPatrol
units.summary: Start vertical stream 13 with motion 29 and animation 38. Paired states probe offsets 15,8 and16,13, subtract the returned Y correction, then alternate motion 28/29 and animations39/38. Contact selects state 3.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeContactOnlyObject
units.summary: Start motion 31, vertical stream 14 and animation 41, then advance state. Its active state only checks player contact and selects state 2 on a hit.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeProximityObject
units.summary: Set persistent update bit 7, clear motion streams and start animation 42. A visible object uses player X separation and random low bits to choose animation 43/motion 32/vertical 15; a later map correction returns it to the stationary state. Contact handling is shared.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeTimedEmitter
units.summary: Initialize motion 33/vertical 17/animation 44 and a zero emission cooldown. At vertical state 18, require visibility and a player position window before allocating a slot, configuring type 27 and placing it at source X+16,Y-2. Sound 49 accompanies emission; a 16-frame cooldown limits repeats.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeSceneTrigger
units.summary: Start the same motion 33/vertical 17/animation 44 without resetting the auxiliary byte. The trigger requires X within128..207, ahead of the player and eligible for object-group contact. It clears qualifying other objects, starts a timed sequence and selects resources32/47.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0RunDropSequence
units.summary: After the48-frame delay, start vertical 54/animation 45. Reaching Y<96 stops vertical movement and starts a 20-frame burst window. Every32nd frame a free slot1..15 may receive type 4 with randomized horizontal/vertical streams at source X-4,Y+20. After the burst, the source exits below Y 208 and releases scene control.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0CollectCountedObject
units.summary: Test bounding-box overlap between player and current object. On contact increment the count modulo20, award an extra life on rollover, remove the object and request collection sounds. Counter units are not identified.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeLinkedEmitter
units.summary: Enable display bit 2 and start animation 3 with zero motion. Every fourth frame, a visible object in the player-relative X window can clear other objects and begin a linked emission sequence.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0CreateLinkedObject
units.summary: At Y 96, select animation 24/motion 30, find an empty slot1..15 and create type 3 with state 7 and animation 61 at source X-16,Y. Save its slot in the source auxiliary byte, request sound 50 and advance the source state.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0WaitLinkedObject
units.summary: Read the saved child slot. When the child disappears or starts vertical movement, stop the parent and wait32 frames after animation 40. Resume motion 30/animation 23, then use paired map probes to alternate falling and supported states. Offscreen flags remove the source and release the scene lock.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0CollectUnitObject
units.summary: Probe below the object to start or stop vertical movement, then test overlap with the player. Contact increments player lives, removes the object and requests sound 33. Correct working Y by the collision displacement on landing.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0ConvertActiveObjects
units.summary: Scan slots1..15. Types5 and above become type 30 with zero state/motion and animation 31; empty and lower types are preserved. Stream cursors reset for each converted object.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeDiagonalAttacker
units.summary: Set persistent update, motion 34, zero vertical stream and animation 46. Subsequent paired states test floor support and player-relative diagonal alignment within24 pixels; random gating chooses stationary/diagonal attack animations or opposite motion/vertical 15. Player contact selects state 9.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0ResolveDiagonalAttacker
units.summary: After the vertical cursor reaches10, probe the map and subtract its correction. Y 160 chooses the next facing animation 46/47 and motion 34/35. Otherwise terrain values masked byEF distinguish special tiles81/82 and select vertical 22/animation 52. Ordinary cases retain shared contact processing.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0ProbeUpperAttackBounds
units.summary: Mirrored terrain probes choose the opposite state when support exists. A small correction below Y 80 can change horizontal direction; Y<16 falls into the paired descending state. Other outcomes share contact handling.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0EmitSideProjectile
units.summary: Animation 46/47 permits allocating type 26 at source X-8 or X+16,Y+8. Child motion 38/39 and vertical 23 encode direction. Request sound 49, restore the source slot, then switch the source to the paired opposite animation/motion.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializePlayerCarrier
units.summary: Start vertical 10/motion 3/animation 53. Visible overlap sets player flag $20, places the player at source X+12,Y+18 and copies horizontal motion/cursor/timer. Both objects share vertical 11, reset vertical cursors, and put player in state 11/animation 19. The source waits until player flag $20 clears before advancing again.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0AdvanceTimedActionPairs
units.summary: A supplies a doubled pointer index into the local script table. Decrement the object timer except sentinelFF; when it expires read an action byte plus duration, select motion/vertical/animation for actions1..5, clear cursors and advance the script cursor by 2. Other actions stop both movement streams. Individual script identities remain unresolved.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeTimedActionObject
units.summary: Clear motion, animation and script cursor, set a one-frame timer and advance state. Six short tail- call entries supply doubled script indices0,2,4,6,8,10 to the common timed-action decoder.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0InitializeLargeEncounter
units.summary: Stop player/object motion and camera command, set display flags3, initialize shared encounter health/timers and request sound $83. Wait on divided frames, perform fade progression, disable rendering and load successive scene maps before restarting display.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0LoadEncounterScreens
units.summary: Use local phase0..2 to draw screen maps25 and26 at zero horizontal origin, restoring map index 23 afterward. Completion clears scroll, resets phase and starts48-frame display flashing.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0FlashEncounterObjects
units.summary: Every eighth countdown step alternate PPU mask16/1E and display flags1/3 on object types16..23. At completion restore normal rendering, select resources2/11 and start a 24-frame delay.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0ShowEncounterGroup
units.summary: Scan slots1..15 and set display flags3 for types whose masked type is16. Restore the active-object X index before returning.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0DimEncounterGroup
units.summary: Scan the same type 16..23 group and set display flags1. This is the complementary flashing pass; the low type bits are not changed.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0RemoveEncounterGroup
units.summary: After the delay clear display/type for the group, restore the active index, set scene control40 and timer 5, and advance two states.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0MoveEncounterLeft
units.summary: Countdown or random choice starts a temporary attack state, saving the prior state. Otherwise test scene collision, move toward X 96 with camera command81, periodically queue alternating text/tile blocks, and inspect contact against the auxiliary object group. A hit starts animation 55 on that object, sound 40 and a 48-frame response while preserving nested return states.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0MoveEncounterRight
units.summary: Mirror the travel logic toward X 160 with camera commandC1. Random low 6 bits and the shared activity/input bytes decide whether to enter the temporary attack state or continue moving.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0RunEncounterAttack
units.summary: An attack lasts24 ticks, switching queued blocks at countdown20,12,4. At the middle event allocate type 28 in slots2..15, randomize its vertical stream and timer, and place it at source X+16,Y+32. Failed allocation restarts the attack wait; completion restores the saved state.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0RunEncounterDamage
units.summary: Count down response time and alternate palette/resource selection every four frames. On expiry decrement the six-unit health field; surviving hits restore saved movement/attack state. The final hit saves position and creates up to six type 16..21 pieces from paired offset and timer tables, then clears type 28/29 objects and begins the transition.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0FinishEncounterDisplay
units.summary: Continue flashing until the transition timer expires, disable rendering, redraw map23 at zero scroll and call the shared scene refresh. Restore object display and rendering, wait96 frames, then remove the encounter controller and enter the shared exit path.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0RunTimedFragment
units.summary: Mark encounter activity each frame; timer expiry stops motion and selects animation 32. Before expiry continue player-contact checks. The subsequent fragment state waits for animation completion, chooses one of four groups of five stream pairs, emits up to five type 29 objects at its position and removes the source.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0CullEncounterFragments
units.summary: Increment shared activity while active; offscreen flags $D0 decrement it and remove the fragment. A following entry removes offscreen objects without contributing activity.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0ConvertFinishedAnimation
units.summary: Wait for animation cursorFF, then replace the object with type 31, vertical 8 and zero horizontal motion. Source types6 and14 choose animation 57 or a random58/59; other types use the same rare alternate choice. Reset state/cursors for the replacement.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: Scene0CollectAnimationReward
units.summary: Probe at 16,8; subtract a nonzero collision displacement from working Y and stop vertical movement. The common continuation tests reward contact and dispatches animations57..60 to four shared reward handlers; otherwise ordinary contact advances to state 2.
units.review_credit: Existing reviewed functional unit; this inventory record is restricted to its intersection with the scaffold partition.

units.name: ForestRightEmitter

Create type 26/display 3/animation 19/motion 28/vertical 13 at an offset from source, then wait48 frames. Movement states choose motion 3/4 or2 with vertical 5/6 and remove the source offscreen. units.name: ForestLeftEmitter

units.name: ForestInitializeHiddenMover

units.name: ForestInitializeTerrainWalker

units.name: ForestInitializeRecoilWalker

units.name: ForestInitializeDiagonalHopper

units.name: ForestInitializeTripleEmitter

units.name: ForestPlaceBurstChild

units.name: ForestBurstChildTerrain

units.name: ForestEncounterDefeatSequence

units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: FinishIntermissionLongWait
units.summary: At delay expiry disable rendering, select resources $22/$2A, reset camera, rebuild page-5 map and clear player status. Begin a $F0-tick main delay and advance mode; otherwise reuse skip handling.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: TickIntermissionFinalDelay
units.summary: Count down the main delay, clear the secondary request and advance mode at zero; otherwise permit button skip.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: FinishIntermissionPlayerSelection
units.summary: If neither saved player remains, clear secondary request and reinitialize stage context; multiplayer also resets shared player fields and calls cleanup before the fixed restart. Otherwise disable rendering and choose mode 3.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: AdvanceIntermissionMode
units.summary: Advance main mode and return.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: DispatchSecondaryIntermission
units.summary: Dispatch through the following inline pointer words using the caller-provided selector in A; no new load of main mode occurs here.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: InitializeSecondaryIntermission
units.summary: Update saved stage records, initialize scroll directions and mirroring, copy the lower-slot scene descriptor into pointer RAM and initialize map dimensions/camera/render state. Advance main mode and stage index, then clear display/map work. Descriptor CPU aliases do not identify bank-13 storage.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: RequestSecondaryIntermissionResource
units.summary: Request resource 5 and advance mode.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: WaitSecondaryIntermission
units.summary: Upper-nibble pressed buttons finish immediately; otherwise decrement the delay on alternating frames and finish at zero. Clear the secondary request and advance mode on completion.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: ExitSecondaryIntermission
units.summary: Disable rendering, reset mode and jump to the fixed continuation.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: FormatCopiedDecimalSuffix
units.summary: Copied decimal formatter suffix: caller supplies leading decimal digit in A and residual in scratch $00. Encode that digit with $30, repeatedly subtract ten to obtain tens, and emit three display bytes at scratch $0A..$0C. This is a supported suffix contract, not a full decimal conversion from arbitrary A.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: UpdateCopiedStageRecord
units.summary: For valid one-based stage index and selected-player flag $40, store a two-byte value in the stage/player record and add it to that player's two-byte accumulated total. Preserve the copy's exact layout and arithmetic; actual caller remains unresolved.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: ComputeUpperVerticalScrollCommand
units.summary: Handle a scroll-direction change only at camera-column boundary with an empty queue, update control flags and rebuild map. In ordinary mode clamp player X and derive an upward/downward scroll magnitude capped at 7 from Y thresholds $78/$C0. Store direction in bit $40 of the scroll command.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: ComputeLowerVerticalScrollCommand
units.summary: Opposite vertical-scroll mode: switch/rebuild only at a camera boundary with an empty queue. Clamp player X and derive magnitude capped at 7 from player Y thresholds 8/$A0; bit $40 distinguishes direction.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: SelectDiagonalScrollCommand
units.summary: Four entries select scroll commands $01/$41/$81/$C1. The common path clamps player Y to 4..$EC and X to 5..$EC before returning; upper bits encode selected directions.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: ResolveGroundPlayerLanding
units.summary: On successful terrain support correct the working Y coordinate by penetration, increment it once, clear vertical motion and choose grounded animation/state. A failed support branch rejoins the prior airborne path.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: ResolveMovingPlayerInput
units.summary: Finish the moving-player terrain probe, apply displacement, reset stream cursors and choose animation/state. Pressed sign bit, special player flags and held action bits select recovery or horizontal movement; ordinary branches enter shared player completion.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: ResolveAlternatePlayerLanding
units.summary: On successful support correct working Y, clear vertical streams and choose animation $0F unless special status suppresses it. Enter state 6 and shared player completion. Failure returns to the preceding unsupported-terrain path.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: StopSoundChannelNonlocally
units.summary: Consume the sound-dispatch wrapper return with two PLA instructions, clear the song-active byte and silence both pulse control registers with $70. RTS returns from DecodeSoundChannelEvent to TickSoundSequencer; this exact nonlocal exit does not authorize arbitrary stack manipulation elsewhere.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: ReloadSoundLoopPointer
units.summary: If the decremented loop count is nonzero, reload the saved loop pointer through the channel record; zero count continues after the loop. Channel bases supplied by the sequencer are $03A0/$03B8/$03D0, so indexed record accesses stay in RAM.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: AddSoundScratchWord
units.summary: Preserve A while adding the two-byte period/scratch operand at $1A/$1B into stream/scratch word $1C/$1D with carry propagation. Actual caller is not established.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: SwapSoundScratchWords
units.summary: Swap the words at $1A/$1B and $1C/$1D while preserving A and X on the stack. Actual caller and whether these words serve sound or general scratch here remain unresolved.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: RestoreSceneDispatchState
units.summary: Balanced dispatch continuation restores saved X and the prior random/frame-state byte from the stack before the accepted return. It belongs to the surrounding dispatcher, not an independent arbitrary entry contract.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: RebuildVerticalMapWindow
units.summary: Load scene descriptor pointer fields, derive a map offset from camera page and row count, then split it into packed address bits. Initialize the PPU row selector from parity and issue shared row/attribute update helpers, followed by a second row offset. Banked descriptor/resource pointers require the current scene mapping.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: ReturnFromIntermissionDispatch
units.summary: Return continuation after the banked intermission dispatcher. Its selector-zero handler has a supported ordinary return; universal return behavior and natural selector coverage are not claimed.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: RestoreSelectedPlayerRecord
units.summary: Copy seven bytes from one of the two saved player records to live player state, selected by session flag $40.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: RestoreSelectedPlayerCamera
units.summary: Restore the two saved camera high-coordinate bytes for the player selected by session flag $40.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: WaitThenBeginPaletteFade
units.summary: Count down the main delay. At expiry select three fade passes and palette cursor $10, then advance mode.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: TickRestartPaletteFade
units.summary: Continue shared palette fade while passes remain. Afterward count down the palette cursor; at zero clear secondary resource, request $22 and advance mode.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.name: RebuildMapThenAdvanceMode
units.summary: Rebuild the vertical map window and advance the main mode before returning.
units.range_note: Functional source-review grouping; gaps retain their separate structural classification.

units.summary: 42 little-endian CPU pointers indexed by the pending mapper resource ID. Targets may alias or revisit earlier records; table order is not serialization order.

units.name: MapperResourceRecords
units.summary: Each record stores count, register class, then count values. Register class increments per value; a record beginning at class0 can reach PRG/control effects, so it is not a blanket bank-preserving operation.

units.name: PaletteResourcePointers
units.summary: 50 little-endian CPU pointers indexed by the pending palette resource ID. Targets may alias or revisit earlier records; table order is not serialization order.

units.name: PaletteResourceRecords
units.summary: Each record stores count, palette destination offset, then count color values. The union of2+count-byte records covers this exact corpus. Shared/overlapping pointer references do not create extra serialized records.

units.name: SoundCommandHandlerPointers

units.name: SoundResourceCorpus
units.summary: Bounded sound corpus containing record pointers, period tables, effect command streams and envelope data. Consumers and repeated command/parameter patterns were inspected; generic bytes between known substructures do not establish complete song/instrument schemas or arbitrary selector domains.

units.name: HorizontalEventHandlerPointers

Spawning commands consume their own3/7/8/10/11-byte record forms; command labels do not imply all input streams naturally occur.

The leading signed vertical-scroll script uses80 as terminator; following motion, palette and sound resources retain generic non-code storage where individual formats are not recovered. units.name: Bank01AuxiliaryHandlers

units.name: Bank01CommandResourceTail
units.summary: Six command-stream pointers followed by low-domain, $FF-terminated command records and scalar bytes. Consumers and neighboring resource/code boundaries were inspected; individual record identities and the complete original schema remain unresolved.

units.name: Bank01TemplatePointers

Pointer-array bounds do not establish complete natural selector use. Lower-slot CPU targets require their actual physical bank context.

units.name: Bank01BootstrapWords

Following code bounds the array; no fallthrough through these data or natural use of every selector is asserted.
